name: Kyarn
source:
Fort Payne, Alabama, 2019

This vacation was a bad idea.

A couple from New York went on vacation to DeKalb county to see a ghost town, and were staying in the nearby city of Fort Payne. 3 days after they arrived, all hell broke loose.  Will they make it, or will they become one of the many bodies littering the streets?

[From [url=https://project-kyarn.itch.io/kyarn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿拉巴马州佩恩堡，2019年

这个假期是个坏主意。

一对来自纽约的夫妇去迪卡尔布县度假，参观鬼城，并住在附近的佩恩堡市。他们到达三天后，一切都乱了套。他们会成功吗，还是会成为街上散落的众多尸体中的一员？
